scope: Baseline of the Isocosm core as at 0f249ae, in release builds on this laptop: both generator families at 256 sites and 8 lineages, both execution modes, population ladders from 256 to 32,768 members with fitted curves, a lineage sweep, a 512-tick history (which died out), a living history cut at 92 ticks by its 20-minute cap, the largest admitted worlds generated and costed but not advanced, a viability check and one ablation. No approximation is built, measured or qualified here. Conclusions about ruling 124's region are scoped to these families, this machine and the fitted curves, and no impossibility is claimed.
